title: Repurposing of DrugBank molecules as dual non-hydroxamate HDAC8 and HDAC2 inhibitors by pharmacophore modeling, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics studies.
authors: Sarkar, Kakali; Debnath, Sudhan; Ghosh, Rajat; Choudhury, Deijy; Chakraborty, Kanak; Saha, Partha; Singha, Achinta; Nandi, Addrita; Goswami, Bidhan; Ghosh, Arabinda; Sil, Samir Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦HDAC8/HDAC2抑制剂药物重定位，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: HDAC8 and HDAC2 are recently reported to be overexpressed in cervical cancer. To date, studies related to the use of dual targeted HDAC inhibitor to treat cervical cancer are not well explored. Again, majority of the selective HDAC inhibitors discovered so far are hydroxamic acids, which have multiple adverse side-effects due to their strong zinc chelating ability. In this study, we repurposed DrugBank molecules to identify novel non hydroxamate compounds as potential HDAC8/2 dual inhibitors that can be effective for cervical cancer management. Therefore, a comprehensive integrated in silico approach, involving two-tier virtual screening, has been adopted. An initial e-pharmacophore model generation based on the co-ligands associated with HDAC8 and HDAC2 and subsequent PBVS of 12223 drug molecules were performed which eventually yielded 658 hits having fitness scores >/= 1.0 for both the proteins. Then, SBVS for these hits was done using Glide XP method into the HDAC8 and HDAC2 crystal structures which resulted in 52 hits having XPGS </= -9.0 kcal/mol against both the proteins. Following this, they were re-docked into other HDAC isoforms to confirm isoform selectivity. DB11747, DB03973, DB03812, DB07890, and DB03448 were identified as top hits and were finally subjected to molecular dynamics simulation for stability of the complexes and MM-GBSA studies to calculate binding free energies. These hits have stable interactions with both HDAC8 and HDAC2 protein binding sites. In silico ADMET studies brought to limelight the promising pharmacokinetics and safety profiles of the hits. In silico cytotoxicity prediction studies also revealed potent anticancer activity.
abstract_zh: 近期有报道称HDAC8和HDAC2在宫颈癌中过表达。迄今为止，关于使用双靶向HDAC抑制剂治疗宫颈癌的研究尚未充分探索。此外，目前发现的大多数选择性HDAC抑制剂均为异羟肟酸类，由于其强烈的锌螯合能力而具有多种不良副作用。在本研究中，我们重新利用DrugBank分子，以识别新型非异羟肟酸类化合物作为潜在的HDAC8/2双抑制剂，有望用于宫颈癌的治疗管理。为此，我们采用了一种综合性的集成计算机模拟方法，包括两级虚拟筛选。首先，基于与HDAC8和HDAC2相关的共配体生成电子药效团模型，随后对12223个药物分子进行基于药效团的虚拟筛选（PBVS），最终获得658个对两种蛋白均具有适应度评分≥1.0的命中化合物。接着，使用Glide XP方法将这些命中化合物对接到HDAC8和HDAC2晶体结构中进行基于结构的虚拟筛选（SBVS），得到52个对两种蛋白均具有XPGS≤-9.0 kcal/mol的命中化合物。随后，将这些化合物重新对接至其他HDAC亚型以确认亚型选择性。DB11747、DB03973、DB03812、DB07890和DB03448被确定为最佳命中化合物，并最终进行分子动力学模拟以评估复合物稳定性，以及MM-GBSA研究以计算结合自由能。这些命中化合物与HDAC8和HDAC2蛋白结合位点均表现出稳定相互作用。计算机模拟ADMET研究揭示了这些命中化合物具有良好的药代动力学特性和安全性。计算机模拟细胞毒性预测研究也显示出其潜在的抗癌活性。
